title: Lava Didn't Destroy Pompeii #Shorts
description:
Pompeii wasn't buried by a river of lava. In AD 79, a rain of pumice collapsed roofs, and deadly clouds of hot gas and ash followed the next morning.

Watch the full documentary, Pompeii’s Final Hours, on Nuviko History: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=15reLbhKUNQ

Historical background: Archaeological Park of Pompeii — https://pompeiisites.org/en/pompeii-map/analysis/pompeii-after-the-eruption/
